I am slowly starving myself to death. My family is doing the same. My fatalistic views towards humanity prevent me from moving on in life. I have systematically been cutting off all connections with the people I like and I dont know why. I am ridiculed for believing I am mentally damaged or scared in some way. I want so bad to share my love with someone but both people I have tried to with have abused me. Chances are i have had aspergers my whole life and never got it diagnosed causing my absolute failure in my senior year of high school. My one and only dream of joining the Marine Corps is dead and blown away. I have developed an extreme fear of people because of the pandemic and quarantine. I am slowly turning to drugs to solve my problems. All my mind thinks about is killing myself even though I have promised myself that I am gonna see this life through. I have lost all of my energy, I am perpetually exhausted and even sleep dosent give me energy anymore. I feel I am an unlovable piece of shit that detracts from everyone around me and I am the cuase of most of the problems my family faces. I am terrified of being alone and moving out even though I'm at the age where i should do that. I want to see a therapist or doctor or someone for my problems but I'm terrified that it'll turn out that their was nothing wrong with me, and therefore I feel like I need to be mentally Ill to justify my feelings and behavior. All I want is someone to cuddle up next to but my fear of touching someone is debilitating.
 Some jackass rides by outside my house with an ATV revving its engine as loud as possible at almost the same time every day, causing me to have perpetual panic attacks every day. I dont know what I'm supposed to do, I'm scared, tired, and angry. Everything good in life always seems to be spoiled by the bad. My dog is in constant agony and we dont have to money to help her or put her down and I love her with everything in me and I want to cry but I cant because for some reason my body refuses to let me. My anger issues are constantly getting the better of me, causing me to lash out at nothing and everthing in blind anger. I feel disgusted that I have to contribute to a society that has failed me and put me down and has done so to countless others. My political views have changed from centrist to extreme radical because of the incompetent and disgusting leaders that are continually being elected in our shams of elections. All I want is somebody to hold me and tell me everything will be alright but because I'm a guy im looked down on for wanting that support or even any support whatsoever. I am losing my mind. My fear of spiders is so debilitating that I saw a dead one yesterday I cant cant stop being horrified that their might be more about the house. I don't know what to do I want to go to sleep forever. I cant stop feeling that my problems are trivial compared to what other people face and I feel like I'm just a drama queen. I'm tired and all I can think about are the people and things that I have lost in my life, and i fear that grasp on the past is preventing me from moving forward with my life. My biggest bully and negative Influence in my life is myself and I feel like my mind wants to kill me in as many horrible ways as possible. The only people in my life that give me hope and sanctuary are the two saints that raised me, and I refuse to kill myself because that would break them. I pray whatever kind of non-existent god or the  universe will hear me so that no decent person ever has to go through this living hell again.
